day_06_am_multi_environment_contract.capability_uat_health: Jira, Confluence and Filesystem UAT should become Passed/100% in the legacy Capability Explorer.

day_07_pm_ppd_promotion_contract.objective: First controlled Pre-Production promotion and clean execution
day_07_pm_ppd_promotion_contract.overall_health_rule: Engine-calculated from governed signals; do not force Green.

day_08_pm_continued_ppd_contract.acceptance_rule: Execution progress may improve, but Overall Health must remain Amber while DRY-DEF-003 is active and PPD remains Partially Ready.

day_09_am_ppd_recovery_contract.history_rule: Day 8 AM failed PPD execution remains in history; Day 9 AM successful retest is the latest execution.
day_09_am_ppd_recovery_contract.aggregation_rule: Governed latest-state aggregation is authoritative; do not force predicted aggregate counts.

day_10_pm_prod_blocker_contract.objective: Detect a controlled Production Verification access blocker after a clean Day 10 AM smoke run.

day_12_am_prod_regression_contract.objective: Detect a true failed Production Verification regression after the stable Day 11 PM state.
day_12_am_prod_regression_contract.aggregation_rule: Governed latest-state aggregation is authoritative; do not force predicted counts.
